notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (curl, tier a) has no Claude-bot disallow, Sitemap: https://burrow.com/sitemap.xml listed. Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl+UA impersonation) retrieved robots.txt, sitemap index, sitemap/collections/1.xml+2.xml (~160 collection URLs), and homepage HTML, but the site is a Shopify Hydrogen/React-Router app: /collections/*.json and /products.json endpoints are disabled (404), and the collection product grid is client-rendered (raw HTML only contains an obfuscated React-Router turbo-stream state blob, no parseable product list or count). Escalated to tier (b): Playwright headless (chromium, sync API), loaded each candidate collection page (wait_until=load + manual scroll-to-bottom loop to trigger lazy render), then read the rendered DOM. No candidate page displayed an explicit 'X products' or 'Showing X of Y' total anywhere, so qty = count of unique /products/ detail-page hrefs in the fully-scrolled rendered grid (per textile.md #28/storage.md #36 fallback: paginate/scroll and count unique product cards). No Claude-in-Chrome (tier c) needed. TREE METHOD: union of main mega-menu (extracted via data-click-id="main-menu_*" attributes in homepage HTML: Bestsellers/Seating/Living/Dining/Bedroom/Office/Outdoor/Rugs & Decor/Storage/Warehouse sections) + sitemap/collections/*.xml (union superset) + each collection page's own on-page category label. Burrow is a modular-furniture/sofa brand organized by room, not by product-type, so most of the ~160 collections are Furniture (sofas, sectionals, chairs, tables, desks, beds, dressers) or Lighting/Outdoor and out of scope for this task. QTY METHOD: see above (unique product-detail-link count after full scroll); one exact-zero case (Outdoor Rugs) confirmed by an explicit empty grid (page header rendered, zero product cards, zero price elements). EXCLUDED and why: /collections/performance-rugs (exact duplicate of /collections/rugs - identical 6 products, different nav alias under Bedroom/Warehouse menus vs Living/Office menus - kept only 'rugs'); /collections/clearance-rugs, /collections/clearance-pillows, /collections/clearance-storage, /collections/new-releases-storage, /collections/ready-to-ship-storage-shelving, /collections/best-sellers, /collections/warehouse* - cross-cutting promotional/sale groupings, not standalone taxonomy nodes (rule: no Clearance/Collections/View-All); /collections/performance-flatweave, /collections/performance-brushed-chenille, /collections/perfromance-lino - confirmed via rendered page (all line items priced $1) to be fabric/rug-material SAMPLE SWATCH ordering pages, not real product listings; /collections/accessories, /collections/seating-accessories - generic aggregator collections whose contents are a strict superset/mix of items already counted under Pillows/Bedding/Sleep Kits plus furniture seat-mod parts (Mercer Inline/Corner Seat Mod, Mercer Block Arm Set); recording them would duplicate rows; /collections/sleep-kits (Nomad/Range/Field Sleep Kit) - a bundled mattress-topper+linen kit sold as one furniture-accessory SKU per sofa line, not a clean bedding/textile category, excluded on ambiguity rather than force-classified; /collections/mattresses - bare mattress product, Furniture/Bedroom boundary, not Textile; /collections/bar-carts-credenzas and /collections/carts-trays - both are supersets/overlaps of Credenzas & Media Storage plus items independently excluded (Dram Bar Cart = serving cart, storage.md #20 excludes serving/dining carts from Storage; Ottoman Tray, Round Tray = decorative trays, storage.md #8/#26 excludes decorative trays) - after removing the excluded items nothing new remained vs. Credenzas & Media Storage, so not recorded as separate rows; /collections/coffee-side-tables - page copy 'Living Room Surface Solutions', no storage function, Furniture; /collections/accent-furniture, /collections/shelving, /collections/bookcases-shelves and all Seating/Living/Dining/Bedroom/Office/Outdoor room-based furniture, lighting, and dining-ware collections - Furniture/Lighting/Kitchen & Dining, out of scope, not touched. Two zero-inventory items were still recorded (Outdoor Rugs qty=0, Covers - Relay qty=0) per the zero-product-category allowance (storage.md #39, applied by analogy to Textile) since the site explicitly shows an empty grid rather than a missing category. LOW-confidence flags: Covers - Relay (textile.md #21 'Furniture Cover -> Textile' supports inclusion, but the URL is sitemap-only, not in the main mega-menu, and currently has 0 products - genuine ambiguity about whether it is still an active taxonomy node); Storage Benches, Wall Shelves, Bookcases, and Credenzas & Media Storage (storage.md #18/#21 list Bookcases/Console Units/Cabinets as 'Potential Furniture' by default - these were included as Storage only because Burrow's own main-nav explicitly buckets them under a top-level 'Storage' menu section with copy explicitly using the word 'storage', and Burrow has no competing top-level 'Furniture' menu to defer to - flagged LOW per storage.md #42 ambiguity-handling rather than silently dropped or silently force-included). No node qualified as both Textile and Storage.
